result_text:
I fixed the typos in the default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add tests for the new matches. I only ran the existing `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer`, which passed.

- **HTML rules:** The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, which is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`. They now cover `.htm` and still cover `.html` and `.xhtml`.
- **`.NET` doc XML and `// Generated by` JS rules:** The path patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` are matched.
- **Gradle JS rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so any `*-gradle.js` file lands in build-and-deployment. The `.gradle` rule is unchanged.

The content patterns are unchanged, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files without those header lines stay in the main scope.
